minutes.headline: Aero Estates hearing closed; counsel to draft conditions for a June 10 vote. Vet waiver and gravel yard site plan approved.
minutes.summary: The board granted a site plan waiver to the veterinary hospital and approved the Cal Stone and Gravel site plan now that the rezoning passed at Town Meeting. Most of the meeting was the continued Aero Estates hearing on remand after a court settlement, ending with the hearing closed and town counsel asked to draft conditions for a vote at the next meeting. Routine minutes, committee reports and a farewell for a departing member followed.

public_comment.topic: A member thanked the departing member for his service on his last meeting.
Asked whether the 10-foot buffer adds to or just maintains what is there; said he was pleased with discussions with the applicant.
Asked about preserving future access from his land through the development to New West Townsend Road, where a retention pond now sits.

votes.motion: Approve waiver of site plan review for the veterinary hospital, with no increase in employees or hours.
Approve the site plan for Cal Stone and Gravel at 181 Shirley Road.
Close the public hearing on Aero Estates.
Approve the April 8 minutes, allowing a member who left early to vote.
Remove the Charter Review Committee from the reports list.
Place an agenda item on the RFP for the master plan at a future meeting.

budget_items.what_was_said: The planner is finishing a planning grant application for a possible match to Town Meeting's master plan funding. She called it a long shot.
Counsel explained how the security amount is set from an estimate reviewed by peer review, with a contingency added.

decisions.decision: Counsel will draft the Aero Estates approval with conditions and share it with the applicant's counsel 10 to 12 days before the June 10 vote; no vote was taken that night.
The master plan RFP will be an agenda item, with board priorities sent to the town manager as a memo.
A site walk with Unitil's forester will be set for a Monday evening once the trees are marked.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board closed the public hearing on Aero Estates and took no vote on the project; counsel will draft conditions for a June 10 vote.
Counsel will draft an Aero Estates approval with conditions and share it with the applicant's counsel 10 to 12 days before the vote.
The board approved the site plan for Cal Stone and Gravel at 181 Shirley Road.
The board approved a waiver of site plan review for the veterinary hospital, with no increase in employees or hours.
The board agreed to put the master plan RFP on a future agenda, with its priorities sent to the town manager as a memo.

why_it_matters: Aero Estates, a development on remand after a court settlement, now moves to a decision on June 10, and the conditions drafted by counsel will set what the developer must do on buffers, access and security.
The gravel yard approval follows the rezoning passed at Town Meeting, and the master plan RFP and grant application bear on how the town plans and pays for future land use.
